title: Spicy Peruvian Fish Stew
description: This Spicy Peruvian Fish Stew is a flavorful and spicy dish that combines the bold flavors of peruvian cuisine with the freshness of the sea. It's a hearty and satisfying meal that's perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: spicy
ingredients.notes: such as aji amarillo pepper sauce

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the aji amarillo pepper sauce and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, honeyed fish, and aji panca pepper to the pot.
Stir to combine and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
Serve with steamed rice or crusty bread for a filling meal.
